ownership.quote: Runtime is a cloud built for AI agents. Its first product is sandboxes: Linux microVMs with their own kernel, which an agent creates, drives and stops by API, CLI, MCP or SDK.

stage.note: No press releases, funding announcements, team/about/careers pages (all 404), Crunchbase profile, or accelerator mention were found for withruntime.com / Runtime LLC. The site's own schema.org data lists the legal name as 'Runtime LLC' with no investor or founder information.

note: The YC directory lists a company named 'Runtime' (batch Spring 2026, https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/runtime) described as 'AI agents for financial operations' — this is a different company from withruntime.com, which is a Firecracker-microVM sandbox/VM cloud for AI agents (per its own /about page: 'Runtime is a cloud built for AI agents. Its first product is sandboxes...'). The two are unrelated despite sharing the name 'Runtime'. withruntime.com's legal entity is 'Runtime LLC' (per its own schema.org markup); its site is very new (pricing/storage changes dated September 2026), has no team/press/careers/blog pages (all return 404), and no funding, investor, or accelerator information could be found via web search, Crunchbase-style queries, or HN. Treat funding stage and backers as unknown rather than assumed bootstrapped or VC-backed.
